description: Render the element server-side and return the image. Unlike a thumbnail this is generated on demand, so it always shows the current geometry — use it to check a model visually before exporting.

elem.description: Element id (tab) — the <elem> segment of the document URL.

out.description: Output PNG path (default onshape-<timestamp>.png in the output directory).

return_image.description: Also return the PNG inline (default true).

view_matrix.description: 3x4 row-major camera matrix as 12 comma-separated numbers (default isometric).

ws.description: Workspace id — the <ws> segment of the document URL.

name: onshape_shaded_view
title: Render the model
